subject: CAIQ control alignment and evidence package for Nimbus Therapeutics
messages:
From: Ruth Baxter <ruth.baxter@nimbustx.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: CAIQ intake: mapping + quick evidence ask

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Nimbus is keen to move Redwood through our procurement track. Attached is our CAIQ starter asking for a control-to-artifact mapping focused on operational controls and data residency. High level ask: can you provide a mapping for the CAIQ controls in scope, and sample artifacts for the ones that typically require evidence (logging, key management, access reviews)?

Priority items for our security team:
- Control mapping for CCM sections: Policy, Identity, Logging & Monitoring, Encryption, Data Protection
- Sample runtime logs showing obfuscation and retention behavior (sanitized)
- KMS/HSM key rotation policy and attestation
- Contact for attorney/procurement on contract timelines

We'd like a first pass by EOD Thursday (Nimbus internal review slated Friday). Please confirm what you can provide and any blockers.

Thanks,
Ruth Baxter
Security Program Manager
Nimbus Therapeutics

Attachments: Nimbus_CAIQ_Request_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Ruth Baxter <ruth.baxter@nimbustx.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake: mapping + quick evidence ask

Ruth — thanks for the note and the CAIQ spreadsheet. We're on it. Quick status and asks: 

1) We can deliver a control-to-artifact crosswalk covering the CCM sections you listed by EOD Thursday. We'll annotate which controls map to our hosted API, Dedicated, and Private deployment models.
2) For artifacts: we can attach sanitized runtime logs (sample), a concise KMS/HSM rotation excerpt, and a SOC2 summary doc. 
3) A small ask: do you need copies redacted to remove customer identifiers beyond standard sanitization? If so, please confirm acceptable redaction rules.

Plan: Naomi will own the artifact pull and redaction; David will compile the mapping and call out any control scope gaps that require contractual language. I'll assemble into a single deliverable and drop in a Drive folder + send a signed evidence index.

Attaching a proposed timeline:
- Wed EOD: internal artifact pull + redaction notes
- Thu AM: draft mapping workbook (v0.9) to Nimbus for quick review
- Thu EOD: final package delivered

If procurement needs a DocuSign or PO-based timeline, loop in procurement@nimbustx.com and I'll put Marissa on the thread.

Regards,
Connor O'Brien
Security Operations, Redwood Inference

--
Connor O'Brien
Redwood Inference
From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-02T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Nimbus CAIQ — artifact pull plan

Team — quick internal note (will send to Nimbus after we assemble):

Summary: Ruth requested a control mapping + sanitized artifacts by Thu EOD. Naomi will pull logs and KMS artifacts; David will map controls; Marissa, pls prepare procurement contact/contract cadence.

Action items:
- Naomi: Export one week of runtime ingestion and tokenization logs, sanitize PII/customer ids, and produce runtime-log-sample.txt (ETA Wed 17:00 PST). Remember to remove traces of tenant IDs and redact IPs.
- David: Fill the mapping workbook (I pre-created a tab in the CAIQ workbook) and flag any controls that rely on customer-managed Private deployment (i.e., cannot be attested for hosted). Include recommended control language for the contract addendum.
- Marissa: Prepare a short note on preferred commercial timelines and whether Nimbus is requesting a dedicated-capacity SLA exception. Add procurement@nimbustx.com to the shared Drive link.

Sanitization note: For runtime logs we will follow our standard evidence-sanitization SOP: token hashes only (no raw input), UTC timestamps only, all IPs masked. Naomi — confirm in your artifact whether any log lines must be excluded entirely.

I'll assemble workbook + artifacts and draft cover note. Keep updates in thread.

Thanks,
Connor
From: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Ruth Baxter <ruth.baxter@nimbustx.com>, procurement@nimbustx.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-03T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: CAIQ deliverable: control crosswalk and evidence package (Redwood -> Nimbus)

Hi Ruth — thanks for the patience. Attached is our first deliverable for Nimbus: a control crosswalk (Redwood_CAIQ_Mapping_for_Nimbus_v1.xlsx) that maps CAIQ controls to Redwood capabilities across Hosted / Dedicated / Private deployment options, plus a short evidence bundle. Highlights:

- Mapping summary: The workbook includes a coverage column (Covered / Partial / NotApplicable) and a recommended contractual addendum for controls that are conditional on Private deployment.
- Artifacts attached: runtime-log-sample.txt (sanitized: token hashes, UTC timestamps, masked IPs), SOC2-Summary-Redwood.pdf (control scope & audit dates), and a short KMS excerpt describing rotation and KMS provider integration.
- Open items: Controls related to customer-supplied key escrow and on-prem hardware HSMs are scoped as "Customer-managed" in hosted mode and are flagged as NotApplicable for Redwood-hosted instances. We provide recommended contract language in the workbook (tab: Contract_Language).

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GdXq-Redwood-Nimbus-CAIQ
HubSpot: HubSpot-125784

Attachments: Redwood_CAIQ_Mapping_for_Nimbus_v1.xlsx (xlsx), runtime-log-sample.txt (txt), SOC2-Summary-Redwood.pdf (pdf)

Please review and let us know if Nimbus security wants an expanded log window or raw KMS audit trails (we'd need a redaction plan and additional time). If procurement wants to start the SOW/commitment conversation, Marissa is copied and can coordinate.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Security Operations
Redwood Inference
